kind: FRED working point evaluated on the lab recordings
notes: Evaluates fred/data/working_points/working_point_bayes_pixelize_track_ss_box_r80.json unchanged (no search, no re-tuning) on all 10 lab recordings, with the lab copy of the pipeline (lab/code/lab_bayes_working_point.py evaluate_point / metrics_from_rows / score_of / write_best) and the base lab caches (lab/frame_data: drone bands 'all', min_present_harmonics 0, as in the FRED caches).

Scored with the objective of its FRED search (mean box precision, box-recall floor 0.8, penalty 3). No skip-start: lab recordings have no lead-in, so whole recordings count. Lab camera is 640x480 vs FRED 1280x720; pixel-based parameters (sigma 20, min_rotor_pixels, min_box_area, alpha) are applied unchanged.
